notes: stop_hook_active is true, so the hook exits 0 immediately without reading a single state file. This is what stops the nudge looping against a model that cannot satisfy it; both harnesses also cap consecutive blocks at 8, and the hook deliberately does not count. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
